THE TOOLBOX / ALL NOTES

A focused shortlist.

Independent software notes, organized by the job you need to do. Use the interactive directory to filter, save, and compare.

Productivity

  • Notion — Give your notes, projects, and team knowledge a shared home.
  • Trello — Move work from “we should” to “done” with visual boards.
  • ClickUp — Bring tasks and project planning into a configurable workspace.
  • Obsidian — Build a connected library of notes that starts with local files.
  • Loom — Explain the work with a screen recording instead of another meeting.

Design

  • Canva — Turn a rough idea into a presentation, social post, or visual story.
  • Figma — Bring product design, prototypes, and feedback into one canvas.
  • Penpot — An open-source space for interfaces, prototypes, and design systems.
  • GIMP — A free, open-source desktop toolkit for editing raster images.

Automation

  • Make — Connect your apps and give repetitive work a better workflow.
  • n8n — Build flexible workflows with a more technical, hands-on toolkit.
  • Zapier — Let connected apps handle the handoffs between everyday tasks.

Operations

  • Tally — A simple way to turn questions into forms people want to fill in.
  • Cal.com — Replace the scheduling back-and-forth with a booking link.
  • Bitwarden — Keep passwords organized and make sharing credentials more deliberate.
  • Clockify — Make the time behind projects and client work easier to see.
  • Toggl Track — Track working time and turn it into a clearer project picture.
  • Jitsi — An open-source foundation for video meetings and conferencing.

Marketing

  • Brevo — Keep customer conversations moving with email and marketing tools.
  • MailerLite — Create email campaigns and landing pages without a heavy setup.
  • Buffer — Plan and publish social content with a calmer editorial rhythm.
  • beehiiv — A publishing platform built around growing a newsletter business.

Sales

  • HubSpot — Give contacts and customer conversations a shared starting point.
  • Zoho CRM — Organize the pipeline, customer details, and next sales steps.
